strategies.text:
Overview

Mega Malamar was one of the original Super Mega Raid bosses debutted during Kalos Tour. It does not serve any PVE value currently. Mega Malamar learns a various set of problematic moves for bug counters. These are peck, psybeam, psywave; all powerful to the typical counters Mega Beedrill or Mega Heracross. Nonetheless with a low attack stat, Mega Heracross can brute force these moves.

Est Time to Win: 210.0s - 270.0s

Main Strategy

Simply DPS with Mega Heracross, dodging problematic moves like Hyper Beam or Psybeam. You may need to rejoin between 3 to 5 time depending on the boss cadence. It is recommended, although not required to Tick Perfect Cast as Fury Cutter is a very EPS centric move.

Additional bug options which do not subtract DPS include Genesect, Kartana and Shadow Vikavolt.
